diagram_math_checks.result: The diagram is the stated based three-strand braid, with bottom labels 1,2,3, upward directed crossing branches and six levels. Read bottom to top its levels are sigma_2, sigma_1^{-1}, sigma_2, sigma_1^{-1}, sigma_2, sigma_1^{-1}, matching Example and Verification 1.1 and the right-factor-lowest convention in thm-geometric-braids-form-a-group.

At every sigma_2 level the right-to-left branch is solid/over and left-to-right branch dashed/under. In the positive (t,x) projection coordinates of def-oriented-crossing-sign-writhe-and-blackboard-framing their determinant is positive. At every sigma_1^{-1} level the left-to-right branch is solid/over, giving negative determinant. This agrees with def-elementary-geometric-half-twist and the item F1, without mirroring or reversing the Borromean convention.

Tracing adjacent swaps independently gives (1,2,3), (1,3,2), (3,1,2), (3,2,1), (2,3,1), (2,1,3), (1,2,3). Thus top labels 1,2,3 match bottom labels. The crossing pairs/signs are (2,3,+), (1,3,-), (1,2,+), (2,3,-), (1,3,+), (1,2,-), agreeing with Verification 1.1; each pair cancels in the signed linking sum. The figure explicitly instructs matching-label outside closure; it depicts the braid only and asserts no drawn closure arcs. This retains the fixed product closure of def-based-string-link-and-labeled-link-peripheral-system.

Component 3 is under only at levels 2 and 5. Using lem-link-peripheral-longitude-word-from-diagram and lem-link-wirtinger-local-meridian-conjugacy yields factors x_1^{-1} and C, where B=x_3^{-1}x_2x_3 and C=B^{-1}x_1B, exactly Verification 2.1. The preserved Magnus convention E(x_i)=1+X_i gives E(x_1^{-1}B^{-1}x_1B)=1+X_1X_2-X_2X_1 mod m^3. The coefficient of X_1X_2 in longitude 3 is mu(1,2,3)=+1 under def-milnor-integer-and-residue-invariants. No relabeling or sign convention substitution occurred.
Verification 1.1-4.1 retains explicit component-position sequence, longitude word and Magnus calculation. The rigorous argument does not depend on reading the figure; no proof text was changed.
